name: belay
description: Runs interactive, project-driven courses inside a coding agent. Discovers courses from a catalogue, keeps progress in the learner's own repository, and loads one lesson at a time.

interface.shortDescription: Interactive courses that run inside your coding agent
interface.longDescription: Discovers courses from a local catalogue, materializes the course into your own repository, and teaches one task at a time. You write the code; the tutor explains, validates and tracks progress. Progress lives in the repository, so a fresh conversation resumes exactly where you stopped.
